title: A Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy Study of VX-880 and VX-017 in Participants With Type 1 Diabetes
notes: Official ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 record checked 2026-10-22: RECRUITING; last posted 2026-09-01 and status verified 2026-08. Current record lists VX-880 and VX-017 arms; overall phase field is Phase 3. Listed primary outcomes: Part A safety through at least 5 years; Parts B/C insulin independence and absence of severe hypoglycemic events 1 year after achieving insulin independence; Part D safety through at least 5 years. No results section was posted.
